sentences.10.1 Jeg gleder meg til bursdagen min: 10.1 I'm looking forward to my birthday
sentences.Sofie fyller 8 år, og hun skal feire bur: Sofie is turning 8, and she is going to celebrate her birthday on Saturday.
She has invited all the girls in her class.
sentences.Det kommer elleve jenter i bursdagen hen: Eleven girls are coming to her birthday party.
sentences.Faren hennes, Bjørnar, må kjøpe pølser,: Her father, Bjørnar, has to buy hot dogs, ice cream and fizzy drinks, and he also has to buy her a birthday present.
He has a lot to do.
sentences.Nå er det bare tre dager til bursdagen m: Now there are only three days until my birthday, Dad. I can't wait.
sentences.Hva ønsker du deg til bursdagen din, Sof: What would you like for your birthday, Sofie?
sentences.Jeg ønsker meg telefon, morsomme spill,: I'd like a phone, fun games, a new bike and money.
sentences.Hva vil du bruke pengene dine til?: What do you want to use your money for?
sentences.Jeg vil spare pengene mine og kjøpe en h: I want to save my money and buy a horse.
sentences.HEST!? Hvor skal den bo? På det lille ro: A HORSE!? Where is it going to live? In your little room?
No, but I really want a horse. Stine in my class has a horse.
sentences.Ja, men hun bor på en stor gård, og de h: Yes, but she lives on a big farm, and they have plenty of room.
sentences.Jeg vil ha både sjokoladekake og ei stor: I want both a chocolate cake and a big cream cake. Can we bake now?
sentences.Huff, jeg er ikke så flink til å bake, S: Oh dear, I'm not very good at baking, Sofie. Can't we buy a cake?
We can bake together! We can do it.
sentences.Vi kan prøve. Først må jeg dra på butikk: We can try. First I have to go to the shop and buy things for your birthday. Then we can bake.
sentences.Du må kjøpe kyllingpølser, ikke vanlige: You have to buy chicken sausages, not ordinary sausages.
sentences.Hvorfor det? Jeg har allerede kjøpt pøls: Why's that? I've already bought sausages.
sentences.To jenter i klassen min er muslimer. De: Two girls in my class are Muslims. They don't eat pork.
sentences.Sofie gleder seg til å feire bursdag på: Sofie is looking forward to celebrating her birthday on Saturday.
sentences.Elleve jenter fra klassen hennes kommer,: Eleven girls from her class are coming, and Bjørnar has a lot to do.
sentences.Sofie ønsker seg mange forskjellige ting: Sofie wants lots of different things and money for her birthday.
She wants to save the money and buy a horse.
sentences.Til festen vil hun lage både sjokoladeka: For the party she wants to make both a chocolate cake and a cream cake.
sentences.Bjørnar må kjøpe kyllingpølser, for to j: Bjørnar has to buy chicken sausages, because two girls in Sofie's class don't eat pork.
Now you must open your present.
sentences.Ja, det skal jeg. Å, denne genseren er k: Yes, I will. Oh, this sweater is really nice!
Do you think so? You can exchange it.
sentences.Den passer helt sikkert, og jeg elsker r: I'm sure it fits, and I love pink. Thank you!
sentences.Noen ganger savner jeg familien min og h: Sometimes I miss my family and my home country.
sentences.Vi vil gjerne invitere dere til bryllupe: We would like to invite you to our wedding from 5 to 7 June.
sentences.Feiringen starter fredag kveld klokka 18: The celebration starts on Friday evening at 6 pm with a barbecue in our garden.
sentences.Vielsen er i Ålesund kirke lørdag klokka: The ceremony is in Ålesund Church on Saturday at 1 pm, and the wedding dinner is at Fjellstua at 4 pm.
sentences.Vi håper dere vil feire denne store dage: We hope you will celebrate this big day together with us, our family and our friends.
